title: 第6章 杀尽天下不义人第7章 百宝堂副堂主
lines: “吞噬之道！”
江玄眼神一亮，他记得在九星神龙诀中记载过，想要铸就至尊霸体，化身真龙，除了修炼九星神龙诀之外，还可以吞噬天地万物，淬炼自身血脉。
而眼前这头烈焰狮王无疑是最好的材料。
深深吸了一口冰凉的空气，江玄的手掌猛的便拍在了狮王的身上，而后九星神龙诀迅速运转开来，吞噬着狮王的血脉。
不一会功夫，只见那庞大的兽身竟开始干瘪下来，而他自身气息也在节节攀升。
“没想到竟然是真的！我的实力又增强了！”
江玄脸色大喜，他发现如今自己的实力又有了提升。
“若是以后能够遇到拥有真龙血脉的灵兽的话，那我实力定然可以得到一个飞跃的提升。”
“公子！”
而就在这时，云曦赶到了这边，看着倒在地上的烈焰狮王，红润的小嘴也是微张。
而在其身后的秦弘等人则是一脸不屑，显然是认为这是江玄利用驱兽粉才得以降伏的灵兽。
许久，云曦这才缓过神来，对着江玄嫣然笑道。
“刚刚还要多谢公子出手相救。
你好，我叫云曦。”
“江玄！”
江玄道。
“江公子，这丛林中灵兽众多，你一个人也很危险，若是方便的话，我们可以结伴而行，到时候路上也好有个照应。”
云曦甜甜一笑，似乎是看中江玄的实力。
“嗤！云曦！你也太看得起他了，这小子刚刚不过是用了驱兽粉，才斩杀了灵兽。
不过，这种方法可不是每次都管用的，到时候说不定还会成为我们累赘！”
还不等江玄开口，那秦弘顿时嗤笑一声。
江玄看了秦弘一眼，他能够察觉到秦弘语气中对他的敌意，这让他的面色有些微冷，自己似乎不曾得罪过他吧！不过他也不在意，像秦弘这样的人，若是他敢做什么的话，自己可以随手击杀。
他笑了笑开口：“多谢云姑娘的好意，不过我这个人独来独往惯了，就不与各位同行了！”
说罢，他便直接离开了，这倒是让云曦有些失望。
“秦大哥，这小子好像把烈焰狮王身上值钱的东西拿走了！”
有同行的少年看了一眼干瘪的烈焰狮王，脸色难看的道。
“放心！他跑不了！”
秦弘冷笑一声，阴翳的眼神闪过一抹杀意！与云曦等人分别后，江玄一路就朝着山林外走去。
看了一眼乾坤囊中一颗颗灵兽晶魄以及灵符，江玄咧嘴笑道：“妹妹的避寒丹可算有着落了，再加上这颗烈焰狮王的灵兽晶魄，还有这些灵符，应该能够换取不少银元。”
一想到这，他的心中就感觉无比舒爽，或许过了今天，他江玄也算是有钱人了！“废物，你给我站住！”
不过就在江玄满心欢喜的时候，一道冰冷的声音忽然传了过来。
江玄抬眼望去，就见对面站着几道人影，那几人赫然是江玄刚刚见过的秦弘以及那随行的几名少年。
content_en:
"The Way of Devouring!"
Jiang Xuan's eyes lit up. He remembered that it was recorded in the Nine-Star Divine Dragon Art that if he wanted to build a supreme hegemonic body and transform into a true dragon, in addition to practicing the Nine-Star Divine Dragon Art, he could also devour everything in the world and temper his own blood.
And the flaming lion king in front of him is undoubtedly the best material.
Taking a deep breath of the cold air, Jiang Xuan slapped the Lion King's body with his palm, and then the Nine-Star Divine Dragon Art quickly started to devour the Lion King's blood.
After a while, I saw that the huge beast's body began to shrivel up, and his own aura was also rising steadily.
"I didn't expect it to be true! My strength has increased again!"
Jiang Xuan's face was overjoyed. He found that his strength had improved again.
"If I can encounter a spiritual beast with true dragon bloodline in the future, my strength will definitely be greatly improved."
"Master!"
At this moment, Yun Xi rushed over and looked at the Flame Lion King lying on the ground, her red mouth slightly opened.
Qin Hong and others behind him looked disdainful, apparently thinking that this was a spiritual beast that Jiang Xuan was able to subdue using the beast-repelling powder.
After a long time, Yun Xi finally recovered and smiled sweetly at Jiang Xuan.
“I just wanted to thank you, Master, for your rescue.
Hello, my name is Yunxi. "
"Jiang Xuan!"
Jiang Xuandao.
"Mr. Jiang, there are many spiritual beasts in this jungle, and it is very dangerous for you to be alone. If it is convenient, we can go together so that we can have someone to look after us on the way."
Yun Xi smiled sweetly, seeming to take a fancy to Jiang Xuan's strength.
"Hi! Yun Xi! You think too highly of him. This kid just used beast-repelling powder to kill the spiritual beast.
However, this method does not work every time, and it may become a burden to us by then! "
Before Jiang Xuan could speak, Qin Hong suddenly sneered.
Jiang Xuan glanced at Qin Hong. He could detect the hostility in Qin Hong's tone towards him, which made his face slightly cold. It seemed that he had never offended him! But he didn't care. If he dared to do anything to someone like Qin Hong, he could kill him casually.
He smiled and said: "Thank you Miss Yun for your kindness, but I am used to being a loner, so I won't go with you!"
After that, he left directly, which made Yun Xi a little disappointed.
"Brother Qin, this guy seems to have taken away the valuable things from the Flame Lion King!"
A young man traveling with him glanced at the shriveled Flame Lion King and said with an ugly expression.
"Don't worry! He can't run away!"
Qin Hong sneered, and a murderous intent flashed through his gloomy eyes! After saying goodbye to Yun Xi and others, Jiang Xuan walked all the way out of the mountain forest.
After taking a look at the spirit beast crystals and talismans in the Qiankun Bag, Jiang Xuan grinned and said, "My sister's cold-proof elixir has been found. Together with the flaming lion king's spirit beast crystals and these talismans, I should be able to exchange for a lot of silver coins."
When he thought of this, he felt extremely comfortable in his heart. Maybe after today, he, Jiang Xuan, would be considered a rich man! "Trash, stop!"
But just when Jiang Xuan was filled with joy, a cold voice suddenly came over.
Jiang Xuan looked up and saw several figures standing opposite. Those people were clearly Qin Hong, whom Jiang Xuan had just met, and the accompanying young men.
title_en: Chapter 6: Kill all the unjust people in the world Chapter 7: Deputy Master of Baibao Hall
